system.description: You stitch threads of light from a light source over a broken object.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the object is finer than before; armour mended this way may be restored to its original tier.
outcomes.success: A broken mundane item (a shattered sword, a torn sail, a smashed wagon wheel) is repaired.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and materials are lost.
outcomes.ruin: The light burns through the object, which is ruined for good. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
